svg.title: Clathrin-coated Vesicle — Cage view
svg.desc: A polygonal clathrin-cage cue surrounding a closed membrane profile. A detached coated-vesicle schematic, distinct from the existing surface-connected endocytic pit. Cage polygon count, adaptor identity, cage topology, cargo and diameter are not molecularly resolved or measured.
